lines.zh: 如果我问你：明天会下雨吗？你心里其实有一个模糊的把握。
lines.en: If I ask whether it will rain tomorrow, you already have a vague sense of it.

lines.zh: 这种把握有多确定？这一期，我们用一个数把它量出来：熵。
lines.en: How certain is that sense? This episode measures it with one number: entropy.

lines.zh: 先记住一句话：熵，是一个分布平均有多意外。
lines.en: Start with one sentence: entropy is how surprised a distribution is on average.

lines.zh: 第一个关键词，不确定性。结果越分散，越难猜。
lines.en: The first word is uncertainty: the more spread out the outcomes, the harder to guess.

lines.zh: 第二个关键词，平均。不是某一次，而是长期平均。
lines.en: The second word is average: not one draw, but the long-run average.

lines.zh: 第三个关键词，下界。它决定了编码一个结果，平均至少要多少比特。
lines.en: The third word is lower bound: the minimum average bits needed to encode an outcome.

lines.zh: 把一个分布写成概率 p。
lines.en: Write a distribution as probabilities p.

lines.zh: 信息量是负 log p：概率越小，意外越大。
lines.en: Information is negative log p: the smaller the probability, the bigger the surprise.

lines.zh: 按概率加权平均，就得到熵的公式。
lines.en: Average it with the probabilities, and you get the entropy formula.

lines.zh: 画出来看：横轴是概率 p，纵轴是负 log p。
lines.en: Plot it: probability p on the x-axis, negative log p on the y-axis.

lines.zh: p 接近 1，信息量接近 0；p 接近 0，曲线陡峭上升。
lines.en: As p approaches 1, information approaches 0; as p approaches 0, the curve climbs steeply.

lines.zh: 把这条曲线按 p 加权平均，就是熵。
lines.en: Average this curve with weights p, and you get entropy.

lines.zh: 这一期，我们把熵拆成三个词、一个公式、一条曲线。
lines.en: This episode reduced entropy to three words, one formula, and one curve.

lines.zh: 下一章，我们用它来衡量语言模型。我们下期见。
lines.en: Next chapter, we use it to measure language models. See you next time.
